name: Bilt Palladium

benefits.name: Points on Rent and Mortgage Payments
benefits.description: Earn points on rent or mortgage paid through Bilt, with any landlord or lender.
benefits.terms: Housing earning is conditional, and sources disagree on the exact mechanics: Doctor of Credit describes 1x points where a 3% transaction fee applies unless offset by Bilt Cash, while CNBC Select describes up to 1.25x with no transaction fee subject to minimum everyday-spend thresholds scaled to your monthly payment. Verify against Bilt's own current terms before relying on a specific rate.

benefits.name: $400 Bilt Travel Hotel Credit
benefits.description: Up to $400 per year in Bilt Travel hotel credits, issued as two $200 credits.
benefits.terms: Two $200 credits per year (one per half-year); must be booked through Bilt Travel. Unused credit does not carry over between halves.

benefits.name: $200 Annual Bilt Cash Credit
benefits.description: $200 in Bilt Cash deposited into your account each year.
benefits.terms: Paid as Bilt Cash rather than a statement credit; Bilt Cash expires yearly with a maximum of $100 carrying over.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Lounge Membership
benefits.description: Priority Pass Select membership with guest access.
benefits.terms: Authorized users (a $95 fee is reported) receive their own Priority Pass membership.

benefits.name: Bilt Rewards Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Bilt Rewards Gold elite status.
benefits.terms: Reported as automatic Gold status for a year by Upgraded Points, while Doctor of Credit ties Gold to a qualifying spend threshold ($4,000 in 90 days) as part of the welcome offer — confirm which applies on an ongoing basis.

benefits.name: 4% Back in Bilt Cash on Purchases
benefits.description: All card spending earns 4% back in Bilt Cash in addition to points.
benefits.terms: Bilt Cash expires yearly, with a maximum of $100 carrying over. Points do not expire. Gift cards, tax payments, and person-to-person payments are excluded from earning.

earningRates.terms: 2x points on all everyday spending — the card's headline feature, with no category management required.

_note: Added 2026-09-14 from the Bilt Card 2.0 launch (live 2026-02-07); replaces the discontinued wells-fargo-bilt. Card art is the genuine MaxRewards CDN asset (slug 'bilt-palladium') and confirms World Legend Mastercard (metal card). Rate figures come from reputable secondary coverage, not Bilt's own terms page (biltrewards.com 403s automated fetches); re-verify the housing rate and whether Gold status is automatic or spend-gated. A $95 authorized user fee is reported but is not representable in the current schema.
